So I went looking for the thing that actually made sense. Not something that sits on your skin. Something that moves what's under it.

No filters. No fake before/afters. Just a tool that does the kneading for you, 10 minutes a night.

settings.question: Does it hurt?
settings.answer: No. It feels like a deep massage, not a workout. Start on the lowest speed and only go up when it feels good. If anything hurts, ease off.

settings.question: I'm thin / I lift / I'm in menopause. Will it still work for me?
settings.answer: Cellulite shows up at every size and every age, because it's about the tissue under your skin, not your weight. Velnoxy works that tissue directly, so it fits your body as it is right now.

settings.question: How soon will I notice something?
settings.answer: Most women feel warm, lighter-feeling legs after the very first session. Changes in how your skin looks take steady use over several weeks. Everyone is different.

settings.question: What if it's not for me?
settings.answer: You have 30 days. Use it every night. If you don't love it, contact support@velnoxy.com for a full refund.
